vu-sensors-e7-name-only.label: PARTIALLY_ALIGNED
vu-sensors-e7-name-only.sourceQuote: Calibrate a thermistor and interpret its resistance-temperature record.
vu-sensors-e7-name-only.explanation: The value statement is only the name of the value; the lesson text describes students calibrating a thermistor, comparing records and repeating unstable readings, but nothing that shows compassion being lived. The value is not unrelated to the lesson (partner work is present), so it is partly fitting, but the statement itself carries no integration.
vu-sensors-e7-name-only.draft: Compassion: while calibrating the thermistor in pairs, students notice which partner is having difficulty obtaining a stable reading and help that partner repeat the affected calibration step before recording their own final values.

vu-sensors-e7-opportunity.label: PARTIALLY_ALIGNED
vu-sensors-e7-opportunity.sourceQuote: Partners follow the supplied thermistor calibration procedure, compare their records and repeat unstable readings.
vu-sensors-e7-opportunity.targetQuote: Compassion during the thermistor calibration practical.
vu-sensors-e7-opportunity.explanation: The statement ties Compassion to the lesson's calibration practical, but neither it nor the lesson text says what students do or decide that expresses the value; the activity only has partners compare records and repeat unstable readings. It is therefore an opportunity, not a demonstrated integration.
vu-sensors-e7-opportunity.draft: Compassion during the thermistor calibration practical: when a partner struggles to obtain a stable reading, students ask which calibration step is difficult and assist that partner with the same procedure before resuming their own readings.

vu-sensors-e7-insufficient-evidence.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

vu-sensors-e7-insufficient-evidence.explanation: The lesson supplies no ILOs, activities or assessment tasks, so there is too little evidence to judge whether compassion is integrated, merely an opportunity, or only named.
